verdict.rationale: Qodo's own platform reviews every pull request automatically, with no human in the loop. Reviews can be set to trigger automatically, configuration can be managed as code via .pr_agent.toml, and MCP is offered for connecting Qodo skills to remote or custom workflows, so the PR-level automation is real. However, the documented CLI is framed for local use alongside coding agents, and nothing shows running Qodo as a step in a CI pipeline. missing for 10: a documented headless/non-interactive CLI mode, CI pipeline integration (e.g. GitHub Actions or GitLab CI job docs), and hands-on corroboration of CI automation.
